description: A canonical public-interest document record. Represents one official publication, report, filing, act, submission, or other source document before structural parsing or AI enrichment.

main.description: Core document metadata for official and institutional documents. Stores identity, provenance, and public context, but not full text, sections, chunks, AI analysis, or ingestion pipeline state.

title.description: Official or source-provided title of the document.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle, section heading, or secondary title.

description.description: Short source-provided description or human-readable abstract. AI summaries should be stored in enrichment records.

documentType.description: Machine-readable document category. Open set; known values cover common official and institutional documents.

source.description: Strong reference to the tech.transparencia.document.source record for the publisher or repository (e.g., DOF, UNFCCC). Identifies which source this document came from.

retrieval.description: Per-document retrieval metadata: canonical URLs, MIME type, checksums, file size, and access status of the specific retrieved representation.

language.description: Primary language of the document content (BCP-47, e.g., 'es-MX', 'en', 'pt-BR').

country.description: Primary country connected to the document, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., 'MX', 'BR', 'US'). Omit for international documents.

jurisdiction.description: Legal or administrative jurisdiction covered by the document (e.g., 'federal', 'state', 'municipal', 'international').

publishedAt.description: When the document was published by the source. Use midnight UTC when only a calendar date is available.

issuedAt.description: When the issuing authority signed, issued, adopted, or approved the document, if different from publication time.

effectiveAt.description: When the document's legal or administrative effects begin, if applicable and explicitly known.

issuingBodies.description: Organizations, public bodies, institutions, or authorities responsible for issuing, publishing, filing, or adopting the document. Uses the shared tech.transparencia.defs#organization type. Conventional role values include 'publisher', 'issuer', 'author', 'adopter', 'filer', 'regulator', 'court', 'legislature', 'repository'.

identifiers.description: External identifiers such as DOF IDs, UNFCCC symbols, file numbers, docket numbers, ISBNs, or local archival IDs. For content hashes use retrieval.sha256; for URLs use retrieval.url.

domains.description: Broad public-interest domains covered by the document. Open set; consumers should tolerate unknown values.

topics.description: Free-form topics, tags, or source categories attached to the document.

createdAt.description: When this AT Protocol record was created.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last materially updated.

retrieval.description: Per-document retrieval metadata for a single retrieved representation. Publisher-level metadata (name, base URL, license) lives on the tech.transparencia.document.source record referenced by 'source'.

url.description: URL where this document was found or retrieved.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical, normalized, or preferred public URL for the document.

htmlUrl.description: HTML landing page or web version of the document, if available.

pdfUrl.description: PDF or downloadable document URL, if available.

sourceId.description: Source-system identifier for deduplication, if provided by the upstream source.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the retrieved representation (e.g., 'text/html', 'application/pdf').

fileName.description: Original or normalized file name, if applicable.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the retrieved file or canonical representation in bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the retrieved file or canonical source payload, if available.

retrievedAt.description: When the source was retrieved by the pipeline.

accessType.description: Access status of the source at retrieval time. Use 'previously-public' for documents that were once publicly accessible but have since been withdrawn or removed by the source.

license.description: Per-document license override, if the document is licensed differently from the source-level default.

identifier.description: External identifier assigned to a document by a source system, authority, archive, or standard. For content hashes use retrieval.sha256; for URLs use retrieval.url.

url.description: Optional URL where this identifier can be resolved or verified.
